name: siya

poses: Relaxed neutral stance, weight centred, arms loose at the sides, feet planted. Unlit sparkler held loosely in the front hand
Small inhale: chest and shoulders lifted slightly, head up a touch, feet planted. Unlit sparkler held loosely in the front hand
Exhale: shoulders dropped slightly, knees a little softer, feet planted. Unlit sparkler held loosely in the front hand
idle.notes: `poses/idle.txt`. Unlit sparkler held loosely in the front hand.

sheet.extraction: connected subjects on common source canvas

poses: Contact: leaning forward, front foot striking the ground ahead, back leg extended behind, arms pumping opposite
Down: front knee bent absorbing the landing, body lowest, back leg starting to swing forward
Push-off: back leg fully extended pushing off the toes, front knee driven high, body leaning forward
Flight: both feet off the ground, legs split front and back, arms pumping, body leaning forward
Anticipation crouch: knees deeply bent, arms swung back, body low and coiled
Take-off: legs fully extended pushing off the toes, arms thrown upward, body stretched tall
Apex: in the air, knees tucked up, arms out for balance
Fall: in the air, legs extended down reaching for the ground, arms raised slightly
Landing: knees deeply bent absorbing impact, arms forward for balance, feet planted
jump.notes: `poses/jump.txt`. In Godot, choose the frame by vertical velocity: 1-2 take-off, 3 apex, 4 fall, 5 land.

poses: Launch: gripping a lit rocket in both hands at arm's length, feet leaving the ground, body pulled forward
Ride: body stretched horizontal behind the rocket, both hands on it, legs trailing together, hair and sari streaming back
Brake: rocket gone, front foot planted and skidding, body upright, arms out for balance
dash.notes: The rocket dash. Used for ground and air dash. Use `--free-palette` for the flame. Poses: "Launch: gripping a lit rocket in both hands at arm's length, feet leaving the ground, body pulled forward" / "Ride: body stretched horizontal behind the rocket, both hands on it, legs trailing together, hair and sari streaming back" / "Brake: rocket gone, front foot planted and skidding, body upright, arms out for balance"

poses: Ready: lit sparkler held up behind the shoulder, weight on the back foot
Lash: arm whipped forward and down, sparkler pointing ahead at full reach, weight on the front foot
Follow-through: arm low across the body, sparkler trailing behind, leaning forward
lash.notes: The J sparkler whip, on the ground. `poses/fuljadi.txt`, with `--free-palette` for the sparks. Hit timing is on frame 2.

subject: full-body
brief: Siya, clean-shaven young adult heroine of Siyaraj and daughter of a fireworks maker. Lean, graceful, expressive side-view game character based on the two user identity references: warm medium-brown skin, long black hair tied back with a loose curl, tiny bindi, simple gold jewelry, marigold-orange sari with crimson red-and-gold pallu, readable hands and feet, holding one unlit sparkler. The approved Basic Rakshas image is a style reference only. Same identity and pose: use a slightly more angular pallu edge with one broad, simple geometric gold border motif; keep all ornament large and sparse.
